inp=np.array(inp); out=np.array(out)
cells=[(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7) if inp[r][c]==8]
ys=[out[r][c] for r,c in cells]
# feature candidates
def feats(r,c):
    f={}
    f['z8']=sum(1 for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1) if (dr or dc) and (not(0<=r+dr<7 and 0<=c+dc<7) or inp[r+dr,c+dc]==0))
    f['z4']=sum(1 for dr,dc in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)) if not(0<=r+dr<7 and 0<=c+dc<7) or inp[r+dr,c+dc]==0)
    f['n8']=8-f['z8']
    # diagonal zeros, straight zeros
    f['diagz']=sum(1 for dr,dc in((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)) if not(0<=r+dr<7 and 0<=c+dc<7) or inp[r+dr,c+dc]==0)
    f['strz']=f['z4']-0
    # 2x2 block counts containing cell
    cnt=0
    for dr in(-1,0):
        for dc in(-1,0):
            ok=True
            for a in(0,1):
                for b in(0,1):
                    rr,cc=r+dr+a,c+dc+b
                    if not(0<=rr<7 and 0<=cc<7) or inp[rr,cc]!=8: ok=False
            cnt+=ok
    f['blk2']=cnt
    # 3x3 all-8 count
    cnt=0
    for dr in(-1,0,1):
        for dc in(-1,0,1):
            ok=True
            for a in range(-1,2):
                for b in range(-1,2):
                    rr,cc=r+dr+a,c+dc+b
                    if not(0<=rr<7 and 0<=cc<7) or inp[rr,cc]!=8: ok=False
            cnt+=ok
    f['blk3']=cnt
    f['r']=r; f['c']=c; f['rc']=r+c; f['rmc']=r-c
    return f
names=['z8','z4','n8','diagz','blk2','blk3','r','c','rc','rmc']
X=[[feats(r,c)[n] for n in names] for r,c in cells]
for i,n in enumerate(names):
    print(n, all(X[j][i]==ys[j] for j in range(len(ys))))
